text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day before the NHK Mile Cup...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Whew! Yeah, feeling good...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Um, about the next training menu—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh! You're done already?
That feels pretty early...
choice_data_list: The gap between races is pretty short, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft seems full of energy, but it's still best to err on the side of caution.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand. I'll believe in everything we've done up until now!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Giving a cheerful reply is all well and good, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Uuungh, I just can't settle down!
Even if I go straight back to the dorm,
I might just be restless the whole time...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's right.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa... There's nobody here...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Saturday's races and the Winning Live are over...
and the stands have fallen completely silent.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Tomorrow, this place... will be packed with spectators who came to watch the NHK Mile Cup.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: All riiiight...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Doing cute things again.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh!!??

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Heart-san...!
You came!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, likely for the same reason as you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm running tomorrow too. Right here.
—In the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Back at the academy, Heart-san is always surrounded by friends, laughing cheerfully.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Still... when that time comes, just stay by my side and smile gently at me.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(......Ever since that interview after the Oka Sho until today, I hesitated to ask.
I wondered if it was okay to ask.
After all, she went so far as to call it 'destiny'—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Why did she choose the NHK Mile Cup for her next race instead of staying on the Triple Tiara route?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I hesitated, but... when our eyes met,
Heart-san's gaze was
so beautiful it sent chills down my spine—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san, ...why?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Why... did you choose the NHK Mile Cup?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll claim the Triple Tiara
and become the future Queen"...
Are you saying she used to proclaim that without hesitation?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...That's true, really.
Or rather—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I have no idea!
Even I still kind of feel like
I don't get what's going on!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know.
It can't be helped, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because that's what my heart is telling me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: There was only one reason I chose the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft.
I wanted to run with you. ...That's all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's just how much—
how much I've come to admire you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I used to think of you as a wall.
A towering wall standing in my way
at the Hanshin JF and the Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Being touched by your determination
to blaze an untrodden path.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...After seeing your running style at the Oka Sho, which never fails to make my heart flutter with excitement, thrust right in front of me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I felt it. My heart started crying out.
...Just like back then.

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text:
"‘Mama! Mama, listen!
Someday, I'm definitely going to Japan!’"

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I'll become one! A future queen!
A Tiara Umamusume just like them—!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: The same urge... the same longing as back then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft. I felt it in you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—But!
Of course, I don't have the mindset of just making memories
with an Umamusume I admire, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I'm the type who wants to surpass the ones I admire. I can't be satisfied just looking up at them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...So, you see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"My dear Rhein Kraft.
Tomorrow, I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble murmur chatter chatter chatter!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It is finally about to begin:
the NHK Mile Cup, gathering swift, young warriors.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With top contenders from the Oka Sho
like Rhein Kraft and Daring Heart set to compete—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The race fans gathered here at Tokyo Racecourse also have eyes sparkling with unprecedented anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The venue's fervor reaches all the way to the waiting room.
I can feel the excitement, expectation, and tension."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It's a situation with quite a lot of pressure, but Rhein Kraft remains as—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm all ready!
I can head out anytime, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Go out there and run your heart out!
Yeah. Go out there and run with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She nodded and gave me a confident smile.
...This is precisely why she
never fails to excite me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: There was only one reason I chose the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft.
I wanted to run with you. ...That's all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's just how much—
how much I've come to admire you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure, on this path.
Just up ahead."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I can grasp what I want to hold.
I can become who I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes—I believe in you!
